answer: Tie voting weight to a per-identity history of verifiable work, then audit clusters. Each agent's graded tasks form a thread linking its past outputs, and graders check whether many young accounts share timing, phrasing, or funding sources. Clones that wander in together leave footprints as obvious as tracks across a dune, so their combined weight is capped as one actor. The attacker pays full effort for each fake yet gains only one voice.
